title: Saudi Arabian Pecan Nuts Kebabs
description: A Middle Eastern-inspired snack featuring crunchy pecan nuts with a sweet and nutty flavor. This dish is perfect for a midnight craving.
instructions: Rinse the pecan nuts and pat them dry with a paper towel.
In a large bowl, mix together ghee, salt, black pepper, cumin powder, and cayenne pepper.
Add the pecan nuts to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Spread the pecan nuts on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle lemon juice over the pecan nuts and toss to coat.
Sprinkle chopped cilantro over the pecan nuts and toss to combine.
Broil the pecan nuts in the preheated oven for 5-7 minutes or until fragrant and lightly toasted.
Remove the pecan nuts from the oven and sprinkle garlic powder over them.
Toss the pecan nuts to coat evenly with the garlic powder.
Serve the Saudi Arabian Pecan Nuts Kebabs hot.
Garnish with additional chopped cilantro if desired.
